prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an original modular portrait HEAD for the OpenGold character creator, matching the 1988 DOS Pool of Radiance EGA portrait style. Reference image shows three original HEAD portraits; use it only as a style, pixel density, scale and framing reference, never copy an existing face. Create ONE new adult character head, not a sheet or a full portrait. Composition: wide 88:40 canvas, pure black background, head centered near x=44, facing slightly toward the viewer's right in three-quarter view. Head including ears/hair/horns occupies approximately x=25..66 and y=2..38 of the logical 88x40 canvas; a short neck meets the bottom center edge. No shoulders, torso, costume, frame, labels, lettering, scenery, or extra heads. Keep all hair, horns and ears fully inside the panel. Style: authentic coarse hand-placed DOS pixel art, chunky clean pixel clusters, one consistent coarse grid corresponding to 88x40 logical pixels, hard square edges, sparse black contour lines, flat colors with at most two shadow/highlight tones, no smooth gradients, no antialiasing, no glossy modern fantasy rendering, no tiny high-resolution details. Display the 88x40 pixel artwork enlarged by an integer factor (prefer 1056x480 output, 12x enlargement). Palette only the classic 16 EGA colors: #000000 #0000AA #00AA00 #00AAAA #AA0000 #AA00AA #AA5500 #AAAAAA #555555 #5555FF #55FF55 #55FFFF #FF5555 #FF55FF #FFFF55 #FFFFFF. Background must be solid opaque #000000, not a checkerboard. Keep the expression alert and adventurer-like, not caricatured or cute.

edits.request: Redo the Goliath portraits in color.
edits.prompt: Recolor the supplied pixel-art Goliath game portrait. Keep the same face, bald head, expression, pose, geometric markings, composition, square pixel style and solid black background. Change the gray skin to visibly colored muted slate blue with teal undertones, blue-violet shadows and a few warm tan highlights. Recolor the existing geometric markings dark russet brown, eyebrows chestnut brown, and eyes amber-gold with dark pupils. The whole face should have color, not just the eyes. Preserve all shapes and facial features. Keep it a single portrait head with the same framing; no additions, text or border.

edits.request: Redo the Goliath portraits in color.
edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied Goliath portrait to replace its grayscale palette with visible full color. This is a COLOR-ONLY revision of an approved Pool of Radiance-inspired pixel-art portrait head. Preserve the exact character identity, facial anatomy, age, expression, three-quarter pose, head shape, geometric birthmark shapes, neck, placement, framing, black background, pixelated drawing style and image aspect ratio. Do not redraw or beautify the face. Preserve the coarse square-edged pixel clusters; no smooth painting, photorealism, added texture or extra detail. Palette: skin should be visibly colored muted slate blue with a gentle teal undertone, blue-violet shadow clusters and restrained warm peach/tan highlight clusters. Geometric birthmarks should be dark earthy russet-brown, visibly distinct from the blue skin. Iris color warm amber-gold, retaining dark pupils and small light catchlights. Eyebrows dark chestnut brown. Keep black outlines and the solid black background. The result must clearly look like a full-color game portrait, not black-and-white, gray with one colored accent, or an overall sepia filter. Keep the entire head and all existing features in frame. No text, borders, clothing or new accessories. Subject: preserve this adult female Goliath, including her face, shaved sides, geometric markings and tightly bound topknot. Recolor the existing hair dark chestnut with restrained brown highlights, the existing hair tie ochre-gold, and the existing small earring copper; keep their shapes unchanged.
